pr_title: roachprod: fail early on startup script errors and make them observable
pr_body:
Previously, when a new VM was provisioned with roachprod a startup script was executed without `set -e` and failures if any weren't captured. This patch fixes these issues by executing the script using `set -eux` and redirecting failure outputs to a `/var/log/roachprod_startup.log`.

Epic: none
Fixes: #120007
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/129574)

I was playing with this branch locally and realized we need to make a few changes to the GCE startup script to be compatible with `set -e`. While I haven't looked yet, it's fair to assume the same is true for the other cloud providers.

Ping me if you have questions or would like some help making the changes!
Tested out the changes by creating clusters on all 3 clouds. PTAL.

issue_context.title: roachprod: fail early on startup script errors and make them observable
issue_context.body:
When a new VM is provisioned with roachprod, a startup script is executed[^1]. Currently, there are at least two points in which we want to improve this:

* The script does not run with `set -e`, meaning any commands that fail will not cause the entire script to fail. This could lead to bugs that are subtle and hard to diagnose.
* Failures are mostly invisible to roachprod. If the script fails and we never create a `.roachprod-inititialized` file, VM creation will just fail when the check for that file times out[^2]. The actual reason for the failure is hidden.

In order to make this process more understandable, we want to be able to use `set -e` in these scripts, and also capture their output. If the script fails, we can display the output the user, which will likely contain the reason for the failure.

[^1]: for instance, for GCE, see https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/549a5c20283de78604d19716963eae482ff19532/pkg/roachprod/vm/gce/utils.go#L41-L238.

[^2]: see https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/549a5c20283de78604d19716963eae482ff19532/pkg/roachprod/install/cluster_synced.go#L1360.

Jira issue: CRDB-36432

review_comments: Can we add a message in the beginning "Sending output to /var/log/roachprod_startup.log"?
The appending of the public key to `authorized_keys` is the key part to also move up, as that is what enables the caller to access the VM.
We can move this line up and then we don't need to pipe the output of the `echo` call above to `tee` (same in other clouds).
